 The GTA 6 Festival is set to take over Miami’s Mana Wynwood on Saturday, November 21, with Rockstar turning the music of Vice City into something fans can walk into. The lineup reads like the game’s own soundtrack. Here we look at the GTA 6 festival date, time, and ticket lottery system, location.  Rockstar Games is not just launching the GTA 6 game in November, it is also throwing an entire festival to go with it. With a lineup stacked with names straight out of the game’s own soundtrack, Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival isn't your usual launch-day celebration; it's Rockstar turning Vice City’s music into something fans can actually walk into. In case you want to attend, check out the GTA 6 festival date, time, ticket lottery system and location. The roster includes Travis Scott, Don Toliver, Kodak Black, Cardi B, Ca7riel, Paco Amoroso, Ca7riel, Paco Amoroso, Metro Boomin and more.
 GTA 6 Festival Date, Time, Ticket Lottery System, Location Explained
 The GTA 6 Festival is coming, but getting in isn't as simple as buying a ticket outright. For the GTA 6 Festival, Rockstar is rolling out a ticket lottery system. The location of the GTA 6 Festival is Mana Wynwood, Miami and the date is Saturday, November 21st, marking the long-awaited release in the loudest way possible. The exact time of the fest is yet to be notified by Rockstar.
 Fans can sign up for the lottery now through Tuesday, November 10th at 4:00 p.m. ET, with just one entry allowed per person, and an age requirement of 17+ to participate.
 Those selected will receive a unique code via DICE by November 10th at 7:00 p.m. ET, which then unlocks access to the general sale happening Wednesday, November 11th at 12:00 p.m. ET. You'd think they were giving you a tour of Fort Knox!
 • GTA 6 Festival Lottery Registration Closes: Tuesday, November 10, 2026, at 4:00 PM ET
 • Winners To Be Notified via Text: Tuesday, November 10, 2026, by 7:00 PM ET
 • GTA 6 Festival Pre-Sale Tickets Go Live: Wednesday, November 11, 2026, at 12:00 PM ET
 The GTA 6 Festival Lineup
 The festival’s roster reads like a soundtrack come to life. Travis Scott, Don Toliver, Kodak Black and SoFaygo take the stage under the Cactus Jack Presents banner, joined by Cardi B, Ca7riel and Paco Amoroso, and Metro Boomin. Justice, who composed the game’s score and contributed several tracks to the soundtrack, brings their own DJ set to the mix as well.
 The lineup doesn’t stop there. Rauw & Friends, Suero, and Tainy round things out, alongside back-to-back DJ sets from The Dare b2b Fcukers, Nick Leon b2b DJ Python, and Prospa b2b Skream. Spread across two stages of nonstop music, the event is being produced by the team behind III Points, in partnership with PlayStation.
 As Rockstar describes it, the GTA 6 Festival promises to let fans 'experience the music of Vice City and Leonida' in just one night. Do note that GTA 6 release date is November 19th.
